The current Gradle build runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the org.hl7.fhir:kindling Maven dependency, after the in-repository IG Publisher was removed as gone to Maven. A later Zulip thread shows BundleRenderer.renderDocument behavior applying the rule in external tooling.
